name: PiToMe protection versus matched quarter-budget ToMe: fixed-native-history diagnostic
status: Frozen exploratory protocol before new cohort inference; engineering and ID gates required
gt_policy: Initial prompt is permitted; subsequent masks only evaluated after diagnostic maps are constructed
matching_space: Native projected post-RoPE memory keys, averaged over heads, using existing Run155 insertion point
budget: Per source-frame 4x4 window, sum floor(predicted-role token count/4), identical across all conditions
history: All conditions replay the identical fixed native memory. Interventions are not written back.
primary: Equal-sequence mean present-target Dice on frozen diagnostic targets; not an unbiased full-video Dice estimate
limitations: Exploratory immediate effects on repeatedly analysed sequences, not full-video or independent confirmation
PiToMe official matcher adapted to SAM2 projected memory; not reproduction of published model/benchmark scores
Quarter-budget ToMe is a matched strategy control, not the archived Run155 full-run score
Protection of low-energy vectors does not establish they are semantically informative; noise may also be isolated
promotion: Require all frozen mean, sequence uncertainty, wins and safety criteria. Engineering-target metrics do not select parameters or candidates.
target_schedule: Uniform post-prompt 10/30/50/70/90% offsets plus each GT-present/empty episode midpoint and first three available frames of every absent-to-present transition. Deduplicate; freeze before inference. Ground-truth strata only define diagnostic coverage, not memory selection.
secondary: overlap in fixed first-three-frame return windows

candidate_screen.statistics: Paired equal-sequence bootstrap 95% CI (10000 resamples, seed20261111), two-sided Wilcoxon with Holm correction across five listed contrasts; require positive CI lower bounds and adjusted p<0.05 on all contrasts required for that candidate.
candidate_screen.safety: No extra pooled false alarms on sampled GT-empty targets; no lower return-window overlap count than native.
candidate_screen.decision: Passing permits a newly frozen full-propagation study only. Failure stops this fixed PiToMe candidate; no margin/budget search on PolypGen. Previously failed ATC/half-budget methods stay stopped.

data_limits: Repeatedly analysed PolypGen cohort; sequence-level grouping does not establish patient independence. Existing DAVIS val only supplies engineering fixture; no independent confirmation here.
timing_amendment: Keep original video length for all native and intervention reads. Bound execution only. Previous six-target prefix results use different object-pointer time normalization and are not the canonical reference.
hypothesis: At a fixed lower budget, protecting distinctive memory representations before merging redundant tokens improves immediate segmentation beyond ordinary matching at that same budget; regional labels may add benefit but are not required for generic PiToMe.
